initiative.title: Standalone charts from data plus a config
initiative.summary: A React host draws any explorEDA chart from rows plus a partial config through a new exploreda/chart entry, with no workspace or cross-chart filtering.
initiative.next_action: Build M1: read-only <Chart> in exploreda/chart with a smoke test over every registered chart type.

sources.anchor: round 3: edit state, settings UI, fields

claims.statement: A colleague renders single explorEDA charts side by side from data plus a config, without the workspace or cross-chart filtering.
React host; deliver as a new exploreda/chart entry in the existing package.
Config is a partial JSON object first; a Dashboard text line is wanted if close to free.
Hover only; no click or brush selection.
All registered chart types, checked by a smoke render.
Plot only, with a title prop that can be turned off; runtime settings editing is key but can be disabled.
Scoped CSS with no global reset or :root variables.
Explicit width and height win; otherwise fill the parent.
Editing is fully controlled: config in, onConfigChange out, host passes it back.
Settings UI as both a gear popover and a separate host-placed ChartSettings component.
A fields prop limits settings choices; without it every data column is offered.

answers: Partial JSON first; DSL if trivial
Plot, title prop, runtime settings editing that can be disabled
Both gear popover and ChartSettings component

shape.problem: The only public way to draw a chart is the full workspace.
shape.recommended_shape: exploreda/chart exports Chart and ChartSettings; each Chart mounts the existing DataLayerProvider with one chart and draws it through ChartRenderer.
alternatives_considered: Per-chart components (BarChart, ScatterChart): more exports, same internals; rejected.
Framework-free render(el, data, config): not needed for a React colleague; below the cut line.
Separate package: extra release work for no gain; rejected.

success_moves.move: Reuse the docs kit path (DataLayerProvider + ChartRenderer) instead of a new chart host.
success_moves.proof: Smoke test renders every registered type through Chart.

success_moves.risk_reduced: Hosts need no knowledge of full settings shapes.
success_moves.proof: A config with only type and field draws.

success_moves.move: Drop filters in updateChart for standalone stores.
success_moves.risk_reduced: Turns off selection without touching each chart.
success_moves.proof: A click on a bar leaves filters empty.

success_moves.move: Make ChartSettings its own provider wired through host state.
success_moves.risk_reduced: No shared store or context between separately placed components.
success_moves.proof: Editing in the side panel redraws the chart.

success_moves.risk_reduced: Style clashes block real use of even a read-only chart.
success_moves.proof: Host button unchanged beside a styled chart tooltip.

first_proof.question: Can the existing data layer host one chart of every registered type with no workspace?
first_proof.artifact: packages/explorEDA/src/chart/Chart.test.tsx smoke test over all registered types
first_proof.decision_rule: Types that fail are fixed in M1 or listed as unsupported before M2 starts.

rabbit_holes: Portaled tooltips and popovers render outside the scoped CSS wrapper.
Some chart types (Composition, Markdown) may need workspace context.

milestones.title: Read-only Chart
milestones.outcome: Every chart type draws from data plus a partial config; two charts side by side on a docs page; hover only.
milestones.proof: Smoke test over every registered type; click leaves filters empty; screenshots at three widths.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Usable read-only charts with workspace CSS.

milestones.title: Scoped CSS
milestones.outcome: dist/chart.css styles charts without touching host styles.
milestones.proof: No :root or element reset in dist/chart.css; host button unchanged in screenshot.
milestones.rollback: Point the entry back at the workspace CSS.

milestones.title: Controlled editing
milestones.outcome: onConfigChange, gear popover, ChartSettings, and fields prop.
milestones.proof: Tests for one onConfigChange per edit and fields filtering; browser edit redraws.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Editable or read-only charts by host choice.
milestones.rollback: Hide the gear; Chart stays read-only.

milestones.title: Dashboard text config
milestones.outcome: config accepts one Dashboard text line.
milestones.proof: Text and object forms draw the same chart.
